entities.name: Rad50 ATPase
observations: The 768-residue query is identical across its full query span to reviewed Aeropyrum pernix Rad50 reference Q9YFZ1; alignment E-value 0 and 100% identity.
The sequence contains an N-terminal ABC-ATPase-like region with Walker A motif GRNGAGKST, followed by a long Lys/Glu-rich helical coiled-coil region.
Pfam detects AAA_15 at positions 4–430, AAA_29 at 4–52, AAA_23 at 6–260, and Rad50_zn_hook at 441–492.
The sequence contains a central Cys-containing zinc-hook region consistent with Rad50 metal binding; the reference binds one Zn2+ per homodimer.
The reviewed reference functions in the Rad50/Mre11 complex during early DNA double-strand break repair, using ATP-dependent conformational changes to regulate DNA-end bridging and resection.
The reference is a homodimer and forms a heterotetramer with two Mre11 subunits; the query is inferred to have the same architecture and complex association.
Sequence-derived properties: length 768 aa, estimated molecular mass 87.5 kDa, theoretical pI 9.05, and net positive charge at pH 7.

entities.name: Mre11
observations: The Rad50 reference is annotated as forming a heterotetrameric DNA repair complex with two Mre11 and two Rad50 subunits.

entities.name: DNA double-strand break repair
observations: Reviewed Rad50 annotation assigns participation in early DNA double-strand break repair and ATP-dependent control of DNA-end bridging versus resection.

entities.name: Rad50 zinc binding
observations: The reviewed Rad50 homolog binds one Zn2+ ion per homodimer through its zinc-hook region.
